---
title: "T-cell State GSVA（手动探索）"
output: html_document
---

此 Notebook **不接入自动 Pipeline**。代码块默认 `eval=FALSE`，请逐块运行并调整基因集、基因 ID、过滤阈值及图形设置。单组雷达图使用该 Group 自身重新打分的 GSVA；跨组分面雷达图和状态轨迹图使用全样本统一打分。两种打分尺度不要直接比较绝对值。

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE)
```

## 1. 输入与基因集

以下基因集是**可编辑的示意起点，不是最终生物学定义**。请根据项目、物种及 Gene ID 修改；基因名必须与 TPM 第一列一致。`coverage` 会展示匹配情况。

```{r input}
find_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  candidates <- normalizePath(c(start, file.path(start, "..")), mustWork = FALSE)
  found <- candidates[file.exists(file.path(candidates, "config.yml")) |
                      file.exists(file.path(candidates, "config.example.yml"))]
  if (!length(found)) stop("请在项目根目录或 notebooks 目录运行。")
  found[[1]]
}
project_root <- find_project_root()
config_file <- file.path(project_root, "config.yml")
if (!file.exists(config_file)) stop("请先创建 config.yml。")
config <- yaml::read_yaml(config_file)

# ggplot2_lib <- config$runtime$ggplot2_lib_loc
# if (!is.null(ggplot2_lib) && nzchar(ggplot2_lib)) {
#   desired <- normalizePath(file.path(ggplot2_lib, "ggplot2"), mustWork = TRUE)
#   if ("ggplot2" %in% loadedNamespaces() &&
#       normalizePath(getNamespaceInfo("ggplot2", "path")) != desired) {
#     stop("当前 R 会话已加载其他 ggplot2；请重启 R 再运行此 Notebook。")
#   }
#   library(ggplot2, lib.loc = ggplot2_lib)
# } else {
#   library(ggplot2)
# }
source(file.path(project_root, "src/t_score/F.t_state_score.R"))

input <- config$input
metadata <- readr::read_tsv(file.path(project_root, input$metadata_file), show_col_types = FALSE)
tpm <- t_score_read_tpm(file.path(project_root, config$gsva$tpm_file), input$gene_column)
counts <- t_score_read_counts(file.path(project_root, input$counts_file), input$gene_column)

gene_sets <- list(
  Proliferation = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "PCNA", "CDK1", "STMN1"),
  Activation = c("CD69", "IL2RA", "ICOS", "TNFRSF4", "CD40LG"),
  IFN_Response = c("ISG15", "IFIT1", "IFIT3", "MX1", "OAS1", "STAT1"),
  Cytotoxicity = c("GZMB", "PRF1", "NKG7", "GNLY", "GZMA"),
  Exhaustion = c("PDCD1", "LAG3", "HAVCR2", "TIGIT", "CTLA4", "TOX")
)

prepared <- t_score_prepare_input(
  tpm, metadata, gene_sets,
  groups = NULL,          # NULL = metadata 中全部 Group
  cycle_order = NULL,     # NULL = metadata 中首次出现顺序；可填 c("R0", "R1", ...)
  counts = counts, count_min = 10, count_min_samples = 3,
  min_tpm = 0, min_samples = 1,
  min_set_size = 2, max_set_size = 300,
  sample_column = input$sample_column,
  group_column = input$group_column,
  cycle_column = input$cycle_column
)
prepared$coverage
table(prepared$metadata[[input$group_column]], prepared$metadata[[input$cycle_column]])
```

## 2. 全样本及各 Group 独立打分

这一步先用 counts（默认 `>10` 且至少 3 个样本）筛选基因，再使用 `log2(TPM + 1)` + Gaussian GSVA；预处理的基因集映射一致，但每组独立调用 GSVA。缺失某些 Cycle 的组可以正常运行，只要求每组至少两个样本。若不希望按 counts 过滤，可把上面的 `counts = counts` 改为 `counts = NULL`。

```{r score}
score_result <- t_score_run(prepared)
dim(score_result$all_samples)
lapply(score_result$by_group, dim)
```

## 3. 颜色与雷达样式设置

下面只需修改两个具名向量，名称必须与 metadata 中的 Group / Cycle 对应；未指定的名称会自动补色。Group 颜色同时用于跨组雷达和轨迹图，Cycle 颜色用于单组雷达。

```{r plot-settings}
custom_group_colors <- c(CQ = "#4C78A8", N396 = "#F28E2B")
custom_cycle_colors <- c(R0 = "#457B9D", R1 = "#E9C46A", R2 = "#F4A261", R3 = "#E76F51")

resolve_colors <- function(levels, custom, palette = "Dark 3") {
  colors <- setNames(grDevices::hcl.colors(length(levels), palette), levels)
  if (length(custom)) {
    if (is.null(names(custom)) || anyNA(names(custom)) || any(!nzchar(names(custom))) ||
        anyDuplicated(names(custom))) stop("自定义颜色必须有唯一的 Group/Cycle 名称。")
    unused <- setdiff(names(custom), levels)
    if (length(unused)) warning("这些颜色名称不在当前数据中，将忽略：", paste(unused, collapse = ", "))
    used <- intersect(levels, names(custom))
    colors[used] <- custom[used]
    tryCatch(grDevices::col2rgb(colors), error = function(e) stop("颜色值无效：", conditionMessage(e)))
  }
  colors
}
group_colors <- resolve_colors(score_result$group_order, custom_group_colors)
cycle_colors <- resolve_colors(score_result$cycle_order, custom_cycle_colors)

# 默认严格沿用参考代码中的 fmsb 雷达图（需安装 fmsb）；"polar" 是上一版 ggplot 极坐标样式。
radar_style <- "reference"
# 参考代码固定 -0.7 到 0.7。若分数超出此范围，请手动扩大；polar 可用 NULL 自动计算。
radar_limits <- c(-1, 1)
```

## 4. 单组雷达：Cycle 为线

```{r group-radar}
group_radar <- setNames(lapply(score_result$group_order, function(group) {
  t_score_plot_group_radar(score_result, group, cycle_colors = cycle_colors,
                           style = radar_style, limits = radar_limits)
}), score_result$group_order)
```

```{r}
group_radar[[1]]
group_radar[[2]]
```

## 5. 分面雷达：Cycle 为 facet、Group 为线

```{r faceted-radar}
p_facet_radar <- t_score_plot_faceted_radar(
  score_result, group_colors = group_colors, style = radar_style, limits = radar_limits
)
p_facet_radar
```

## 6. 状态轨迹：每个指标一张小图

横坐标严格来自 metadata 的 Cycle；缺失轮次不会补造样本。线与点为各组均值，浅色带为均值 ± SEM（也可选 `sd` 或 `none`），半透明点为单个样本。

```{r trajectories}
p_trajectories <- t_score_plot_trajectories(
  score_result, ncol = 3, group_colors = group_colors,
  error = "sem", show_samples = TRUE
)
p_trajectories
```

## 7. 确认后保存

请先观察图形，按实际 Group/状态数量调整 PDF 尺寸，再运行本块。

```{r save-scores-and-plots}
output_dir <- file.path(project_root, "figures", "t_state_score")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
data_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data", "t_state_score")
dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(score_result, file.path(data_dir, "t_state_scores.rds"))
readr::write_tsv(t_score_long(score_result$all_samples, score_result),
                 file.path(data_dir, "t_state_scores_all_samples.tsv"))
for (group in names(score_result$by_group)) {
  group_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "by_group", group)
  dir.create(group_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  readr::write_tsv(t_score_long(score_result$by_group[[group]], score_result),
                   file.path(group_dir, "t_state_scores.tsv"))
}
for (group in names(group_radar)) {
  t_score_save_radar(group_radar[[group]],
                     file.path(output_dir, paste0("radar_", group, ".pdf")),
                     width = 7, height = 6)
}
t_score_save_radar(p_facet_radar,
                   file.path(output_dir, "radar_by_cycle_all_samples.pdf"),
                   width = 11, height = 8)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "state_trajectories_all_samples.pdf"),
                p_trajectories, width = 12, height = 8)
```
